t: Computer science lesson plans for K-8 from the Tennessee STEM Innovation Network.
steps: Search for the TSIN Digital Readiness lesson plans and check that the pages load.
Contact TSIN if the official pages still return an error.
Confirm the cost and the license.
Choose the grade band set for your class.
Check which tools and accounts the lessons need.
Look at the CS Integration Guidebook.
Match the lessons to your own standards.
